vibe_rationale: Real gravel community in a rural Alentejo setting, but a race-first UCI qualifier with little culture programming.
fit_notes: Adult endurance riders suit recovery and hydration, and the 2025 Škoda naming shows a non-endemic brand will partner. The 2026 race is days away, so 2027 is the realistic target, and as an Australian brand High Ground would need a local partner.
